piv['delta'] = piv['2025-10-20'] - piv['base_mean']

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
acct = df[df['account_id']=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()
d20 = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')
base_dates = [d for d in acct['date'].unique() if d < d20]

# check all rows on 10/20 with num_instances much higher than their baseline
rows = acct[acct['date']==d20].copy()
base = acct[acct['date'].isin(base_dates)].groupby(['application','instance_family'])['num_instances'].mean().rename('base_ni')
rows = rows.merge(base, on=['application','instance_family'])
rows['ni_delta'] = rows['num_instances'] - rows['base_ni']
print(rows.sort_values('ni_delta', ascending=False).head(10)[['application','cloud_service','instance_family','num_instances','base_ni','ni_delta','unblended_cost']])

# also check total delta
print("total delta:", acct[acct['date']==d20]['unblended_cost'].sum() - acct[acct['date'].isin(base_dates)].groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().mean())
